pages.title: Getting started
pages.description: Install GhostVue and render your first component.
pages.body:
# Getting started

Install GhostVue and render your first component.

Run `pnpm add @ghostvue/vue`, then import a component such as a button.

pages.title: Button
pages.description: Accessible button primitive with native semantics.
pages.body:
# Button

Accessible button primitive with native semantics.

GhostButton renders a native `<button type="button">` by default.

## Usage

Pass `disabled` to remove the button from the tab order. Consumers own every visual detail through parts and themes. Consumers own every visual detail through parts and themes. Consumers own every visual detail through parts and themes. Consumers own every visual detail through parts and themes. 

## Keyboard

Space and Enter activate the button, matching the platform.

pages.title: Dialog
pages.description: Modal dialog with a focus trap.
pages.body:
# Dialog

Modal dialog with a focus trap.

The dialog moves focus to its first tabbable element and returns focus to the trigger on close.
